The '''Eriadu Patriots''' were a [[Shockball/Legends|shockball]] team, likely based on [[Eriadu/Legends|Eriadu]], before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]; [[Kob Mondray]] played for them for a time.
